purpose: Turn a placed design into an evidence-backed client supply report without detaching its Product Twins or avatars.
graph: PROJECT -> SPACE -> PLACEMENT -> PRODUCT_TWIN -> CONFIGURATION -> AVATAR + OFFER -> LOGISTICS_ROUTE

percentage_bases.line_items: Each distinct placement line has equal weight.
percentage_bases.unit_quantity: Each placed unit is weighted by placement quantity.
percentage_bases.merchandise_value: Quantity times current unit price; emitted only when every included line has a current comparable-currency price.
percentage_bases.landed_value: Quantity times current landed or installed unit cost; emitted only when every included line has comparable-currency evidence.

classification_rules: A Spain-language or Spain-territory catalogue is not proof of a Spanish supplier or Spanish dispatch origin.
LOCAL_MARKET_CONFIRMED requires seller_country or dispatch_country to match the destination country plus authoritative delivery confirmation to the project destination.
A delivery-time bucket requires authoritative destination delivery confirmation and a dated minimum/maximum lead-time promise.
An authoritative unavailable result for the exact destination is DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE_CONFIRMED; it is not silently reduced to a generic unresolved state.
A known exact catalogue route that still needs address, stock, checkout or quote refresh is ROUTE_REFRESH_REQUIRED, not confirmed delivery.
No joined offer or usable route is UNRESOLVED.
All panels retain unknown states and must total 100 percent on their stated basis.

required_gates: same design role or explicitly approved role change
selected colour, finish and material review
current destination offer and delivery evidence
substitution_rules.principle: An alternative can improve candidate coverage, but it cannot be counted as confirmed coverage until every gate passes and the client approves the design change.
substitution_rules.conditional_scenario_rule: A confirmed alternative offer may be evaluated as a separate what-if coverage scenario. The scenario must retain all open gates, price and fit deltas and can never replace current design coverage before approval.

freshness_policy: Offer, stock, price and delivery evidence must carry observed_at and expires_at or be labelled LIVE_REFRESH_REQUIRED before quote, approval or purchase.
